scope: All ordinary files under installed game, recursively, suffixes txt/gui/info/asset/dlc, original and every installed DLC; no link traversal; no EXE read. Localization is presentation and excluded by extension. Match includes comments; matches are not automatically overrides.
zero_match_meaning: No authored spelling matching this broad holy/site+max/min/limit token pattern in the enumerated text files; not proof that native code has no alternative nonmatching mechanic.
